new_value: Already implemented — under the gate CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_CLAIM_REPLAY (Kconfig:371, default y, depends on SLOT_COORD+SETTINGS) rather than the CONFIG_LICHEN_GCP_CLAIM_SEQ_PERSIST name this bead proposed; the existing gate fulfills the same requirement and is wired into the build (coap/CMakeLists:72 zephyr_library_sources_ifdef slot_claim_settings.c). Strong implementations exist in slot_claim_settings.c:181 (lookup) and :205 (commit) overriding the __weak stubs in coap_slot_coord.c:570-590: per-gateway-IID claim_seq high-water with NVS settings persistence (settings_save_one + lazy settings_load_subtree rebuild, one Settings entry per gateway IID as u32 LE), monotonic never-regress logic ('never regress the floor even if a concurrent gate check raced'), and the caller already honors persist-first ordering (coap_slot_coord.c:514-520 rejects the claim with LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_PERSIST when commit fails — increment-before-claim ordering per GCP-6.5). Host-test coverage via lichen/tests/coap_keys_lifecycle (settings backend compile-checked per prj.conf). The bead's requested gate-name difference is cosmetic; renaming would churn prj.conf consumers for no behavioral gain. No code change needed.
